decisions.reason: CAD-file retention is a separate documentation decision already represented by the candidate's message-176 MODIFY; retaining the wiring layout does not further change the CAD requirement.
The wiring-layout retention decision does not require another BOM or change any current BOM selection or completion attribute.
Retaining wiring documentation may assist future servicing but does not change the machine's required physical service access.
The documentation-retention decision does not alter the requirement to keep liquids separated from electrical components.
Wiring-layout retention does not change dispensing-path cleanability, removability, sanitation access, or liquid-trap prevention.
Retaining the wiring layout does not change which materials must be food-safe at food-contact locations.
The wiring-documentation retention decision does not change the required leak-free behavior of the plumbing and seals.
Retaining wiring documentation does not modify the prototype's off-the-shelf component strategy.
The wiring-layout retention decision does not change whisk removal, tool-free detachment, or cleaning behavior.
The wiring-layout retention decision does not change bowl removal, clearance, or rapid swapping behavior.
Retaining the wiring layout for future development does not change the prototype's selected 120V wall-power source.
The wiring-documentation retention decision does not change the solenoid control mechanism, dispensing sequence, operator control, or flow behavior.
